scope: Final entry: retain the 439 reviewed structural predictions, fill only the 31 previously blank contests. No refitting or hyperparameter search for this release.
objective: Pick the most probable named winner under the final hybrid forecast; do not optimize against Kalshi.
outcome: Eventual winner of the 2026 seat election, including any required runoff or ranked-choice count.

primary_rule.description: Among the current leading pair, use their most recent completed common election. Halve the observed two-person margin, allow a 15 percentage point standard deviation for change, and convert to a normal tail probability. This is a judgmental completion rule, not an estimated calibration.

open_louisiana_rule.description: For LA-05 and LA-06, use a judgmental 90% Republican party-win prior based on the 2024 presidential lean on the current map. Allocate 9% to Democrats and 1% to other outcomes. Within each party, average equal candidate weights and weights proportional to square root of reported receipts plus USD 10,000. Include only candidates in the ballot registry. This is not a fitted candidate model or a simulation of runoff transfers.
